item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Ready for today? Let's find out what the weather is like on this Friday, October 16. It's Friday. The weekend is very nearly here! Here in Shanghai, the day will be cloudy. The warmest part of the day will be 27 degrees, and the coolest 20. It should feel gently warm all day. There is a 27 percent chance of rain. The sun goes down at 5:21 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Cloudy days are perfect for the library or a museum. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be drizzly, reaching 29 degrees. Still thinking about jumpers and socks this week. Has anything surprised you? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
